title: NixSpawn
body:
# **Nix Spawn**
This plugin adds /spawn
Command teleports player to spawn you can select by using command /spawn setspawn
You can easily edit messages in config.yml

Why you must choose Nix Spawn?
- Lightweight
- Supports many versions
- You can easily change messages

# **Source code**
Source code is public
Link: https://github.com/NightCraft666/NixSpawn
